messages.notifications.password.reset.subject: Password reset
messages.notifications.password.reset.title: Reset your password
messages.notifications.password.reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
messages.notifications.password.reset.description: Use the button below to choose a new password. This link is valid for a limited time.
messages.notifications.password.reset.fallback: If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
messages.notifications.password.reset.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.
messages.notifications.email.verification.subject: Verify your email
messages.notifications.email.verification.title: Verify your email address
messages.notifications.email.verification.intro: This email address was added to your account.
messages.notifications.email.verification.descrip: Use the button below to confirm that this email address belongs to you. This link is valid for a limited time.
messages.notifications.email.verification.fallbac: If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
messages.notifications.email.verification.ignore: If you did not add this email address, you can safely ignore this message.
messages.notifications.login.notification.subject: A sign-in to your account was completed
messages.notifications.login.notification.title: New account sign-in
messages.notifications.login.notification.intro: We detected a sign-in to your account.
messages.notifications.login.notification.was.you: If this was you, no action is required.
messages.notifications.login.notification.not.you: If you do not recognize this sign-in, change your password immediately and terminate active sessions.
